Null only after the full read (and the long-document search below) finds no official number; when the candidate number is ambiguous, leave the field out and record it in `supplementary` instead of guessing.
guide.jurisdiction: name: The state or country under whose law the entity is organised (for example "Delaware").

guide.action_items: list: At most 3 concrete actions the recipient is asked to take, with deadlines if stated. None: `[]`.
guide.additional_recipients: list: Further To, cc'd or copied parties as written. None: `[]`.
guide.communication_date: date: The date the communication was **sent**, not a deadline, meeting date or invoice date. Null if no send date is stated.
guide.demand_amount: money: Exact dollars the sender demands the recipient pay (218440.00 for "$218,440.00"). 0 is a stated amount. Null when no amount is demanded **of the recipient**: an amount that is only reported (an invoice total in an internal follow-up, money owed by someone else, an amount the sender will sue a third party for) is not a demand. Never compute or convert.
guide.recipient: name: The named addressee: the first `To:` entry as printed (a person, a distribution list or a group such as "All Enron Houston"), else a salutation that names a person or a defined group ("Dear GISB Members", "Houston Attendees:"). A generic salutation ("Dear Friends", "Gentlemen", "All", "To Our Readers") is not a named addressee: null. Press releases and wire articles with no named addressee: null. When several people are in "To", put the first one here and the rest in `additional_recipients`.
guide.sender: name: Who sent it: full name, title and entity as written. Press or wire: the issuing company or media-contact line. Null only when no sender is named.
guide.urgency: label: `routine`, `time-sensitive`, `urgent` or `critical`. Never null. Neutral or unspecified is `routine`. `time-sensitive`: a near deadline or a dated request. `urgent`: stated urgency ("ASAP", "immediately", "urgent"). `critical`: legal, financial or safety consequences stated as imminent.
